craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Grant suspends; question-hangs demanding-place (apodosis in v45 per UNC). Rejected: (a) landing blow here → killed: blow lands v45. Read aloud: SAY-grant-ED … THE-ques-TION-hangs, de-MAND-ing-PLACE.

lines: Say granted — still, when purpose ends, before the freed soul's face,
what stops the churn? The question hangs, demanding place.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti cet tatsamāptau api puruṣārthe api taṃ prati

reads_against.argmap: Granted — then what, for the freed? → The grant suspends; the blow lands in v45.
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
